scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact result solely for classical unweighted degree-two Bernstein–Durrmeyer spectral powers on L²(0,1), with comparison to degree one. It does not imply a strongly continuous semigroup on the entire Hilbert space, cover higher degree or weighted operators, or establish full historical bibliographic priority. Decimal transition values are approximations; proof uses analytic inequalities. Finite computation is supplementary, not independent validation.
title: Disconnected positivity times of quadratic Bernstein–Durrmeyer spectral powers
